gitCommit.body: Epic C PR2 — "Not mine" (set aside) (#249) * plan: Epic C PR2 (Not Mine / set aside) task-by-task Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq * feat(triage): "Not mine" set-aside affordance + persistent inline undo (Epic C PR2) Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq * feat(triage): durable "Set aside" list + bring-back (Epic C PR2) - BringBackControl: ghost "Bring back" → idempotent DELETE disposition + router.refresh(); in-flight guard + gentle role="status" error (mirrors DeferControl/SetAsideControl). ULID-not-slug per the dispositions API. - /collections/[id]/sort/set-aside: Server Component mirroring triage auth (getSession→/login, requireCollectionAccess). Composes the curator-scoped, set_aside-filtered data path (DispositionController.listDispositions → ItemController.listItems filter → PhotoController covers). Calm, COUNT-FREE list + person-side empty state. ULID to BringBackControl, slug for nav. - Quiet, count-free "Set aside" link from triage (ink-soft, below the decision). Tests: BringBackControl.test.tsx (jsdom: DELETE URL + refresh, error, double-tap); set-aside-list.integration.test.ts (un-mocked pg: only A not deferred-B, and a second curator sees none — curator-scoped). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq * refactor(set-aside): use CardImage for covers (calm broken-load fallback) (Epic C PR2) Whole-task review minor: raw works but CardImage degrades to the calm ☾ fallback on a failed cover load instead of the browser's broken glyph (gentle-by-duty-of-care). One image convention, like ItemCard. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq * test(e2e): Not-mine set-aside + bring-back across viewports (Epic C PR2) Adds e2e/not-mine-set-aside.spec.ts (runs in all 3 viewport projects): set aside the focused triage item via "Not mine" → it leaves the flow → the persistent inline undo notice and the dedicated count-free "Set aside" list both bring it back, awaiting the real 2xx POST/DELETE side effects (no sleeps). A second test asserts no count/backlog framing on triage or the list. Also adds a "set-aside" screenshot surface to capture.ts (a journey scenario with one set_aside disposition) so light+dark shots of the list are produced, and raises the screenshots-config per-test timeout — the capture test walks every surface sequentially and the new surface tipped it past the 30s default. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq * fix(set-aside): hoist inline undo outside the empty-state branch + a11y (Epic C PR2 whole-branch review) Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq * chore(graphify): refresh graph for Not-Mine set-aside (Epic C PR2) Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq --------- Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8
